# GeoGebra Classic — Quarter-circle arc length (2D)
# Paste these lines one per row into the GeoGebra input bar (Algebra view),
# then File > Share to publish and obtain a material ID.

t = Slider(0, pi/2, 0.01)
SetValue(t, 0.9)
arc = Curve(cos(s), sin(s), s, 0, pi/2)
SetColor(arc, 160, 160, 160)
traced = Curve(cos(s), sin(s), s, 0, t)
SetColor(traced, 0, 102, 204)
SetLineThickness(traced, 6)
P = (cos(t), sin(t))
SetColor(P, 204, 0, 0)
SetPointSize(P, 5)
rvec = Vector((0, 0), P)
SetColor(rvec, 255, 153, 0)
vvec = Vector(P, P + (-sin(t), cos(t)))
SetColor(vvec, 0, 153, 0)
A = (1, 0)
B = (0, 1)
s = t
txtLen = Text("Arc length  s(t) = " + Round(s, 3), (-1.15, 1.45))
speed = Text("|v(t)| = 1", (-1.15, 1.15))

# Tip: right-click t and choose "Animation On" to sweep the quarter circle.
